title: Brood stock acquisition; exclusive property rights.
bodyText: The cultured progeny of wild plants and animals lawfully obtained by brood stock acquisition are the exclusive property of the person who cultured them or that person's successor in interest.
bodyHtml: [§141-56]  Brood stock acquisition; exclusive property rights.  The cultured progeny of wild plants and animals lawfully obtained by brood stock acquisition are the exclusive property of the person who cultured them or that person's successor in interest. [L 2022, c 134, pt of §2]
